title: 15in1 Solitaire
diagnostic_scope: Read-only private kernel tracing and bounded FEX IR capture; actual game code and assets unchanged.

ipad.gc_callback_consumes: Private instruction analysis: copies context prefix [0,0xd8), records separately supplied interrupted RSP. No FPU/context-tail loads in this callback.
ipad.pointer_array_fault_scope: Guest stack argument array used by virtual method calls. Does not identify the producer or prove the cause.

host_signal_contract: Passed under native x86-64 Wine with fixed high guest arena; private context diagnostics do not change callback or wait semantics.

mac_comparison.first_terminal_gpu_error: Metal command-buffer out of memory, followed by VK_ERROR_DEVICE_LOST and abort in VideoOut
mac_comparison.result: Does not isolate or qualify the iPad CPU failure.

next_investigation: Trace production/copy of the stack pointer array and compare the same command on native Windows and Wine/FEX. Do not patch around invalid pointers, disable GC, or bypass Vulkan validation.
privacy: Raw logs, game instruction listings, callback traces, shader inputs and diagnostic kernel remain in ignored local build directories.
